title: At every support point the density ratios are at least the a.e. lower density bound
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (a : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ (y : Euclidean N) (ρ : ℝ), μ (closedBall y ρ) ≠ ∞) → (∀ y : Euclidean N, MonotoneOn (densityRatio n μ y) (Ioi 0)) → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n μ y θ ∧ a ≤ θ) → ∀ y ∈ μ.support, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → a ≤ densityRatio n μ y ρ
